fusions.name: Sudden Swell
fusions.desc: You inflate to your full bulk in an instant, dealing 14 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: First Meal of Spring
fusions.desc: A mauling bite that deals 30 damage, leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds and heals you for 25% of the damage dealt. A boss or elite also loses 5% of its maximum health.

fusions.name: Wintering Mud
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second to you for 8 seconds. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

fusions.name: Fat for the Thaw
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 15, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second.
